objective: Clean a longer interview rough assembly after rejecting an over-eager J-cut, then accept a follow-up L-cut that holds the expert line under the reaction.

clips.name: cold-open
clips.transcript: so uh the real mistake happens before anyone opens the timeline

clips.name: false-start
clips.transcript: wait no I want to say that again because that sounded backwards

clips.name: expert-answer
clips.transcript: the reliable fix is to let the thought finish while the viewer sees the reaction

clips.name: reaction
clips.transcript: listener reaction after the expert finishes the sentence

clips.name: demo-insert
clips.transcript: screen detail showing the safer cut point

clips.name: wrap
clips.transcript: use this review pass before you accept the final assembly

edl:
*** Begin EDL
*** Trim Clip
@@ anchor: clip_uuid=cold-open
+ start: 1.2
+ end: 7.5
*** Delete Clip
@@ anchor: clip_uuid=false-start
*** Set Audio Trail
@@ anchor: clip_uuid=expert-answer
+ trail_s: 0.48
+ reason: rejected the early incoming J-cut and held the expert line under the reaction instead
+ confidence: 0.88
*** Set Cut Intent
@@ between: clip_uuid=expert-answer and clip_uuid=reaction
+ cut_type: l_cut
+ intent: hold_expert_thought
+ audio_relation: audio_trails
+ confidence: 0.88
+ reason: user rejected the first J-cut; follow-up L-cut keeps the thought intact under the reaction
*** Set Cut Intent
@@ between: clip_uuid=reaction and clip_uuid=demo-insert
+ cut_type: insert
+ intent: visual_evidence_cover
+ confidence: 0.82
+ reason: demo insert confirms the safer cut point after the reaction
*** Set Output Format
+ aspect_ratio: 16:9
+ platform: youtube
+ safe_area: standard
*** Set Package Metadata
+ platform: youtube
+ title: Review the cut before accepting
+ description: Longer rough assembly with a rejected J-cut and accepted L-cut follow-up.
+ tags: editing,review,l-cut
*** End EDL
